status: written before current repository acquisition and outcome inspection
scope: Existing adopted room declarations and direct relations only. Ordinary Manual main; Semi, doorway, scope-incomparable and quality-ineligible behavior kept separate.
primary_question: Does a person's same-room performance contain reproducible information after subtracting source-view public quality and external stable personal quality?

source_features.public: Per source view, mean formal Q of other eligible workers, excluding the target worker; then mean over this worker's actually available source views.
source_features.external: Worker's mean leave-one-peer quality residual on eligible ordinary tasks outside the target building; recomputed from actual records.
source_features.own_surprise: mean(source Q - source other-worker Q) - external; zero means the source performance is explained by public room level and stable worker difference.
source_features.class_surprise: Source same-class leave-worker-out quality beyond public source quality; class features are derived from the provided corrected building-excluded labels, never refit here. Expected external class effects will be separated when supported.
source_features.budgets: All existing m>N/2 splits retained. Single-source direct pairs are a distinct budget and support, not an extension of the main denominator.

descriptive_outputs: Exact common-worker source/target Q, leave-worker-out residual, common-pool residual, rank, low-tail status, external historical level and residual surprise
Per-pair, per-declaration and per-person differences, correlations, signs, low-tail transition rates and actual support
Balanced common-worker by-view matrices for descriptive worker/view/interaction sum-of-squares decomposition; overlap and eligibility explicit
prediction_families: Fixed public + external + half own surprise
Same calibrated baseline plus own surprise
Same calibrated baseline plus class source information
Same calibrated baseline plus own and class source information
Fixed shallow robust boosting as a nonlinear supplement, paired baseline and extended features
Building-excluded calibrated low-tail probability, baseline versus own/class increments
validation: Every fitted coefficient is learned outside the outer target building. Recomputed training personal-history features also exclude the outer target building and each training target building. Provided taxonomy labels for all rows are the outer target-building-excluded version. Exploration and internal building checks remain explicit, never represented as future external validation.
evaluation: Common support within each comparison; source combinations average within target answer and history budget, then workers within image, images within building, buildings equally. MAE, bias, ranking, low-tail probability and worst-error strata remain distinct. Labels and outcomes are never chosen to improve target scores.
stopping_rule: Complete these prespecified information comparisons, inspect group/person mechanisms and retain null or adverse increments; no repeated outcome-guided tuning until a positive result appears.
